name: Local models
description: A client for language models that run on this computer: it finds the model servers already running here (Ollama, llama.cpp and any OpenAI-compatible server), lists their models, and chats with them in threads kept as files, the answers streaming in with their speed. Nothing leaves the computer: every request goes to a local address.

commands.title: Local models: open
commands.description: Open Local models, on a thread when one is named.

commands.title: Local models: new chat
commands.description: Start a new chat, with a model when one is named.

model.description: A model's name, as its server lists it
